claim: The Freepass covers the Romancecar to Yumoto, the Tozan trains and buses, the ropeway and the pirate ship, plus discounts at the Open-Air Museum and Glass no Mori.
fix: The Freepass covers the Odakyu line fare to Odawara (one round trip), the Tozan trains and buses, the ropeway and the pirate ship, plus discounts at the Open-Air Museum and Glass no Mori. The Romancecar limited-express ticket (about ¥1,200 pp Shinjuku to Hakone-Yumoto) is a separate charge.
source_quote: 特急ロマンスカーは別途料金が必要です
